picks.editorial_note: A Pritzker Prize for AI-enabled antibiotic discovery validates a years-long push to use deep learning for drug discovery and signals growing recognition of AI's role in solving the antibiotic-resistance crisis.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to 5% of its shares (potentially $100 billion) to the public is one of the largest equity commitments in the AI industry and raises major questions about how AI wealth gets distributed.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC's strategic framework agreement, anchored by a new dedicated AI institute, marks a significant deepening of academia-finance collaboration on AI in Asia.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A $24.5 million NSF-funded national research infrastructure project puts Nebraska at the center of securing AI-driven science nationwide, a notable federal investment in AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: Nebraska to lead cybersecurity for national AI research project

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's AI-guided 'plug and play' vaccine design achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in trials, a concrete demonstration of AI accelerating public-health-relevant vaccine development.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showing AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely synthetic self-generated data challenges assumptions about the necessity of real-world training data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding to modernize a widely-used fusion simulation tool with AI exemplifies how big tech philanthropy is accelerating AI-driven progress in fusion energy research.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, Case Western-led multi-institutional effort using AI with satellite imaging and health data to study environmental drivers of Alzheimer's represents a substantial federal bet on AI for neurodegenerative disease research.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, shows agentic AI tools being formally adopted into national lab scientific workflows under a federal initiative.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $3.2 million NIH-funded ASU project using deep learning on retinal imaging for early Alzheimer's screening could enable cheaper, more accessible preclinical disease detection.
picks.title: What the eye may reveal about Alzheimer’s
